description: Changes one conversation, named by id, by whichever of these are given: assignee_id (a member’s usr_ id; null takes the assignee off), snoozed_until (a time; null ends the snooze), labels (the whole list of labels, replacing the old one), priority, and state. state resolved marks the chat Done, as the Done button does: nobody holds it afterwards and every automation on that number treats the customer’s next message as a first message. The change stays inside Cosend, out of the customer’s view. Returns the conversation.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

title: Update a conversation
